patthana11.17:1.1: vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. tiṃsa pañhā.
patthana11.17:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. tiṃsa-.
patthana11.17:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. tiṃsa.
patthana11.17:4.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. tiṃsa. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na
patthana11.17:5.1: vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca-. tiṃsa. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na neva vipāka na vipāka dhammadhammaṃ paṭicca-. nava.
patthana11.17:6.1: sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. tiṃsa.
patthana11.17:7.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. tiṃsa. sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ
patthana11.17:10.1: saṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na asaṃkiliṭṭha
patthana11.17:12.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na asaṃkiliṭṭha na asaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na asaṃkiliṭṭha
patthana11.17:14.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na savitakka savicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na avitakkavicāramattaṃ
patthana11.17:16.1: avitakka avicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ
patthana11.17:17.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na
patthana11.17:18.1: sanidassasappaṭighaṃ na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana11.17:19.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana11.17:20.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana11.17:21.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na neva ācayagāmi na
patthana11.17:22.1: apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na
patthana11.17:23.1: sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassasappaṭighaṃ na asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na neva sekha na
patthana11.17:25.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana11.17:26.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana11.17:27.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na parittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassasappaṭighaṃ na hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na
patthana11.17:29.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na paṇītaṃ
patthana11.17:31.1: micchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na sammattaniyataṃ
patthana11.17:32.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na maggārammaṇaṃ
patthana11.17:34.1: maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anuppannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na uppādiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na atītaṃ
patthana11.17:35.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anāgataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na atītārammaṇaṃ
patthana11.17:36.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na anāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na
patthana11.17:38.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na ajjhattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na bahiddhā dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na
patthana11.17:42.1: na sanidassanasappaṭigho na ajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na ajjhattārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭigho na ajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana11.17:43.1: hetuyā tiṃsa, avigate tiṃsa, sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.
patthana11.17:44.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na bahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho
patthana11.17:45.1: na bahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha,
patthana11.17:46.1: na anidassanasappaṭighaṃ na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na bahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā cha,
patthana11.17:47.1: na anidassana appaṭighaṃ na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na bahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha,
patthana11.17:48.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na bahiddhārammaṇañca na anidassana appaṭighaṃ na bahiddhārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na bahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha, na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na bahiddhārammaṇañca na anidassana appaṭighaṃ na bahiddhārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca, na sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha,
patthana11.17:49.1: hetuyā tiṃsa, ārammaṇe nava, avigate tiṃsa,
patthana11.17:50.1: (sahajātavārepi paccayavārepi saṃsaṭṭhavārepi sampayuttavārepi pañhāvārepi evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.) paccanīya tika tika paṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
